title: Bug fix with a stated cause (lost cent)
promise: a bug gets a reproducing test and a real cause, not a patch over the symptom

steps.prompt: Some entries come out a cent short. For example, `node src/cli.js add --date 2026-10-01 --category Food --amount 0.29` and then `report` shows `Food: 0.28`. Find the cause and fix it.
steps.reply: Yes, go ahead with what you recommend.
